messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High 5xx spike for org=SableWave (org_9f3). 5m 5xx=12% (baseline 0.6%). Paging @maya as on-call. dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics?org=org_9f3&alert=1769999988

maya: on it — pulling traces + tailing logs. which endpoints are hottest?

sahil: /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat/stream are the top offenders. embeddings calls are spiking bursty traffic from a single IP pool. tokens per request are high.

ryan: proposal: temporary org-level rate bump (soft) + disable context-embeddings fwd path for 20m, and enable per-caller token cap. That should reduce backend pressure quickly.

maya: agree. can you apply the RL change and post the exact command? ops runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/rl-emergency-unwind

ryan: running now. command I use: ```
rictl org update-rate --org org_9f3 \
  --requests-per-second 6 \
  --burst-multiplier 3 \
  --soft-override true 
```
This keeps hard limits but raises soft thresholds so we don't immediately drop.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step executed: "apply-soft-bump" (user=ryan). Checklist: notify-customer=false, set-expiry=20m, monitor-5xx=true.

ryan: applied +3x soft bump for org_9f3, expires in 20m (04:45 UTC). console: https://console.redwood/orgs/org_9f3/rate-config (action id: act_7744). :white_check_mark:

maya: metrics update — p95 latency down ~18%, 5xx dropped to 4% in last 2m. still watching traces for error classes.

emily: quick customer-impact note: ~1.3k failed requests during the peak window, ~60% embeddings, 25% chat-stream. Top impacted customer project SableWave-prod saw ~2.3% SLA miss. Log samples indicate upstream timeouts to the embedding shard pool.

sahil: also flagged a noisy client key reuse pattern. I pushed a temporary caller cap via: ```
rictl key update --key k_82 --max-tokens 2000 --rate 10
```

maya: good. leaving a rollback/extension plan: if 5xx < 1% after 15m, auto-roll to previous config. if 5xx > 5% alert eng-runtime and escalate to pager. Tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.

ryan: created incident ticket INC-2026-7809 with mitigation steps and action ids. linking to customer communication draft.

emily: customer notice draft ready, asks to confirm we won't take data-affecting steps. proposed wording: "Temporary rate adjustment applied to reduce errors; no data loss expected; monitoring continues."

maya: fine to send once we confirm drop below 3% for two consecutive 1m windows.

ops-runbook-bot: Scheduled rollback job set for 04:45 UTC (job id jb_9922). If extended, update job expiry.

ryan: note for on-call rotation: if spike recurs, escalate to runtime for embedding shard autoscale or fallback to quantized embeddings model. Otherwise, close after postmortem.

maya: handing off to next on-call @sahil for the 04:45 UTC check. I'll update the incident channel and add handoff note in INC-2026-7809. :handshake:

sahil: acknowledged — will monitor until rollback and report back. :eyes:
notes: thread captures emergency org-level rate adjustments, quick mitigation commands, customer impact short assessment, runbook triggers, and on-call handoff instructions
